lines: Minerva's voice lines and sound effects.
- "When Nightingale gives you the green light, report back."
- "Frankly our only concern is the current whereabouts of Neci Rusalka. Kaya Velasco is helping with the practicalities. If you need incentives, we have them."
Velimir: "Gonna have to cut prices again. People just don't wanna buy furniture in a lockdown."
- Minerva: "Great, all the more custom for my side of the trade."
Minerva: "Tactical solutions are available to discreet buyers."
Velimir: "Remember how romantic this city was the first time we came?"
- Minerva: "Yeah, I had to close up your stomach wound with a staple gun."
Minerva: "We need to get after her, Velimir. She's still our responsibility."
- Velimir: "So we keep on working with Kaya until something turns up!"
Velimir: "Well I coulda fixed this place up better than Captain Teabag!"
- Minerva: "You're insulting our hosts, and you're embarrassing me."
- Minerva: "I have genuine Scaldra hardware. Clean, untraceable. No credit."
- "Welcome to where the old soldiers wash up."

- "I don't know how much Nightingale's told you, but Velimir and I were assigned to Höllvania to achieve one key objective: secure and, if necessary, terminate Major Neci Rusalka. Since we'd be working undercover, our supervisors fitted us out with authentic Scaldra weaponry, at massive expense. Now that everything's gone to hell in a handcart, we're selling them off cheap. Our loss, your gain."
- "These should level the playing field somewhat."
- "Take Viktor's troops on with their own arsenal."
- "Look what I've got. Efervon-based weaponry. Banned in most civilized countries."
- "Brutal, efficient and reliable. Don't let the pedigree put you off."
- "There's a certain savage justice in taking the oppressor down with their own weapons. Don't ya think?"
- "Scaldra must be stopped by any means necessary."
- "Fine, we went to a lot of trouble to keep these out of the hands of Scaldra."
Minerva: "Velimir. Enough with the cutesy little ice crystals."
- Velimir: "Don't know what you mean. Drifter's not complaining."
Velimir: "You really think Neci will want to see you again?"
- Minerva: "Gods forbid we don't give ever everything she wants."
Minerva: "Are you going to keep picking at those bar snacks?"
- Velimir: "(muffled crunching) I dunno. You gonna keep riding my ass about it?"
Velimir: "Heh. When she finally gets up, that bar stool's gonna have a truly epic butt print. Shh."
- Minerva: "Ignore him, Drifter. It's an easy feat to learn, trust me."
Minerva: "Being stuck here with you reminds me of my RTI training."
- Velimir: "That so? Reminds me of the time I got locked in a chemical toilet and rolled downhill."
Velimir: "Well you see, Drifter. It was her voice that first captivated me. Like a rusty nailgun marinated in cooking sherry."
- Minerva: "Ah, Velimir. The soul of a poet trapped in the body of a frathouse couch."
Minerva: "You need to think about what we're going to offer Neci if you ever want to get her back."
- Velimir: "She had the respect of every single Scaldra goon in this city! What do you suppose made her want that so bad?"
Velimir: "Whatever happened to you and me, Minerva?"
- Minerva: "You know damn well what happened."
Minerva: "Believe it or not, Velimir was quite the operative, once. Until his priorities shifted."
- Velimir: "You're goddamn right. Becoming a parent is meant to do that."
Velimir: "Look, Minerva, you hate me, I get it. So leave. Nobody's forcing you to stay here."
- Minerva: "Not a hope. We made this mess together. We'll fix it together."
Minerva: "He used to love buying me chocolates. Funny how he doesn't do that any more."
- Velimir: "Found out it was poisonous to dogs."
Velimir: "Hey, hey, go easy on the Old Fashioneds, Minerva. You know Kaya could call on us any time."
- Minerva: "Yeah, wouldn't want to let her down too, now would we?"
Minerva: "Would you frost my glass a little, good sir?"
- Velimir: "One frosted ass, coming right up."
Velimir: "How did a bum like me end up hitched to a queen?"
- Minerva: "Staying power, honey. That big old glacier just ground me down."
Minerva: "Mmm. My feet are aching after that last run."
- Velimir: "You, uh, want me to take care of that? I can close up for a few."
Velimir: "Do you see what a beauty I get to look at all day, Drifter?"
- Minerva: "Oh, he plays the romantic. But we both know what base and wicked thoughts are circling in that fishbowl of a brain."
Minerva: "He's devoted to me, Drifter. Like a loyal pet."
- Velimir: "What can I say? I crave my belly rubs."
Velimir: "I know they're our friends, but if any of those Hex try putting the moves on you, there's gonna be trouble."
- Minerva: "So crass and yet so charming. My very own thawed-out caveman."
Minerva: "Don't keep us busy too long, Drifter. We do have other business to attend to."
- Velimir: "Aww. She's acting coy. Isn't she cute when she does that?"
Velimir: "You want some ice on those bruises?"
- Minerva: "What a contrived way to ask me to undress."
Minerva: "Ya know, Quincy's been doing good work with the local kids. A lot of them have been left without parents. If Neci never comes back..."
- Velimir: "Let's make that decision when the time comes."
Velimir: "I never meant to be a soft touch. I just loved seeing our kid's eyes light up when I said 'yes'."
- Minerva: "Oh honey, kindness isn't a weakness, Velimir."
- "Beckett should have any necessary tech specs."
- "Come back when you've made your mind up."
- "You know I'm taking a risk here, right?"
- "Nightingale vouched for you, so I assume you know what you're doing."
- "If it was furniture you were after, talk to him."
- "Whatever will Vel and I get up to alone?"
For full dialogue including responses, see Temporal Archimedea/Quotes.
- "Alright Velasco, you got me. What's so important about a concert?"
- "Temple and the Rippers gig in Solstice Square, Neci was here? In the time before the time we're in now?"
- ""If you remember it, you weren't there.""
- "Good to know I'm risking my neck in a noble cause."
- "Until Viktor's tantrums start. I'm on it, Ms Velasco."
- "Enemy numbers dropping. Scaldra opposition are as relentlessly mediocre as predicted."
- "Ms Velasco? Half the Scaldra force has been permanently silenced. Check your signals."
- "Velasco, tell me that was worth it."
- "I'm up for whatever, Velasco, as long as it can help us find out what happened to Neci."
- "Hey, if stomping all this Techrot keeps 'reality' intact. I'm here for it."
- "Ms Velasco, we have already terminated half the designated targets. I do hope your note-taking is keeping up."
- "Confirming extermination proceeding as planned. Midpoint reached. No significant issues."
- "Elimination quota has been met. Did you get what you needed, Velasco?"
- "Just so long as this was all worth the effort."
- "Yah, chemistry was more my thing, but… you lead the way."
- "Oh gah...Sure wish Scaldra had put up this kind of fight before they lost their Hell-Scrubbers the first time around."
- "You call that a spore cloud? I'll show you a spore cloud."
- "That's a wrap, did you get what you need?"
- "Hello! Kaya! Reading Hell-Scrub towers ahead. Will proceed as if that's the plan."
- "Wait? When would you have put Peely Pix on a Hell-Scrubber? You know what, it's better if I don't know. "
- "Oh god, try smelling it from our position. Burnt plastic is potpourri compared to this stuff."
- "Let me get this straight. You detect one of your little stickers on a Hell-Scrubber, and you can use that to track changes in the timeline?"
- "And that's time. Hell-Scrub complete. Remind me again why it has to be this hard?"
- "Hell-Scrub objective met. You sure this is worth it, Velasco?"
- "Get your equipment ready. The cat and I will deal with the Legacyte."
- "Does the Techrot mourn its lost children? Let's go, Kalymos."
- "Look, we're basically devouring the Techrot's young here. Can you blame it for wanting to change history?"
- "The hivemind isn't happy with me, Kaya! I hope this is worth it!"
- "Far be it from me to undermine the confidence of youth. "
- "It means something's pushing back against what we're trying to do here. Next target, Kaya. Go!"
- "We got orders. Hard-target. The kid needs us to scrap one of Viktor's new toys. "
- "We're the security detail, aren't we? Oh well, you've taken me on worse dates."
- "Nobody touches a single immaculately placed hair on Flare's head. You've got my word."
- "Don't get any ideas. We've got a job to do."
- "Come on. Show's over, Vel. Time to go home."
- "Wait, you're saying we already deep-sixed these guys and if we don't put 'em down again, the wheels come off the universe? That tracks. Vel, let's go."
- "At least the Techrot are mindless drones. What's your excuse, Scaldra?"
- "Look. I trust the kid, Vel, I do, but this is some heavy voodoo. What if, I don't know, what if we can't make things right? "
- "Extermination quota fulfilled. We're heading for exfil, Velasco."
- "I know, but maybe we can stop the same thing from happening again."
- "Hey, Kaya, you think that with your research into all this timeline stuff that there's a chance we could stop Neci from ever joining Scaldra?"
- "What's the deal with all these Peely Pix? Don't we have more important things to worry about? "
- "Jeez you're not kidding. I'm going to need a Hell-Scrub after this mission. Gods, so much Techrot."
- "I always thought science was a lot more stuffy than this. "
- "You better be getting what you need, Velasco."
- "So, Velasco, I got a question. Was the Techrot part of the original timeline or is this all Entrati's doing?"
- "All Legacytes eliminated. Is our mission complete, Velasco? "
- "Okay, Velasco, all assignments completed as outlined. We are coming home. Velimir, all this timeline nonsense is making me thirsty."
- "Well, I'm the reason humanitarian warfare protocols exist."
- "Everything truly delicious in life is bad for you."
- "I offer you poison of an excellent vintage."
- "Minerva Hendricks. Saryn. You know my reputation."
- "If you're calling on me, this must be serious."
- "How should I put this? I specialize in groups."
- "Let's make the kind of statement that people don't walk away from."
- "Okay, so, bar-room scrap or international diplomatic incident?"
- "Whatever we get up to is going to be on your conscience."
- "Agent assigned. Let Velimir know I'm on the case."
- "The most toxic creatures always have the most striking appearances."
- "Call ahead. Clear any civilians out of our path."
- "No non-combatants. I'm a killer, not a monster."
- "The sweetest poison in the finest of vessels."
- "Well, hope it wasn't getting too traumatic for you."
- "Oh, please. You don't have to escape. You weren't being dissolved."
- "You come back when you're good and ready. Huh."
- "Ugh, shrug me off like a second skin."
- "Huh. I feel empty. Not sure I like it."
- "I appear to have lost my passenger."
- "Ah, there you are, flesh and blood."
- "Oh, just as I was getting used to having you in my head. Hmm. What?"
- "I assume this maneuver is for sound, tactical reasons."
- "No time for pleasantries. Do what you must."
- "Fascinating. I must ask Ms. Velasco to explain how this all works."
- "Get it done and get back. We're strongest as a unit."
- "How do you not weigh anything? God, I'd kill for that."
- "Think you can walk in these shoes?"
- "Yeah. Let's get one thing straight. There is no one that can do what we do."
- "What do you suppose goes through their heads when they see us coming?"
- "Do you feel how strong this plague-bearing body has had to be?"
- "Must be like diving into a hot tub brimming with strychnine."
- "Well, wrap yourself around my spinal cord and hold on tight."
- "Ooh, the genie is back in the bottle."
- "I know you'll handle this body with respect."
- "Ugh, rough jaunt. Let me secrete you some dopamine."
- "Try to ignore the pain from any old war wounds."
- "Order me a double Hibernian over ice when this is done, would you?"
- "I trained this body hard. Now we both get to benefit."
- "These fools are just begging for an infection."
- "One at a time or all at once. It ends the same way."
- "Ha ha ha! Whoever they are, they have no clue who they're dealing with."
- "Why don't we turn this chance meeting into a massacre?"
- "And now you melt away like Velimir's snowflakes."
- "I spy some clowns who haven't read my dossier."
- "You'll run out of ammo long before I run out of spores."
- "This is about to get messy and upsetting."
- "Remember my face while yours is melting off."
- "Do you not know who you're up against?"
- "Oh yeah, piss off the toxic spore lady, that'll end well."
- "Are you kidding me? Send me a challenge."
- "Yeah, when you need a job done right."
- "Bodies piling up around me yet again."
- "Really? You were so easy to break."
- "This ends our brief and unpleasant relationship."
- "You end up against an Apex predator. What did you expect?"
- "You know what's funny? There's always some vital part you can rip out."
- "Haha! One more for my board, Velimir."
- "Stay the hell out of my personal space."
- "Were you trained by a drunk? What's wrong with you?"
- "Oh, come on. At least make me break a sweat."
- "Agent Hendricks is down! Move to assist!"
- "Either someone helps me up, or I find a new squad!"
- "Remember, you can shed your skin now, Minerva!"
- "Down. I'm down. Come on, squad, where are you?"
- "This is not time for grudges. So if you're in range, help me!"
- "Come on! You heard of protecting your assets? Help me!"
- "Ugh, vital signs, failing. Get me an assist!"
- "You! Help me up! Then we find the one who did this!"
- "I can do this. I can... do this. No... help."
- "You want me to bleed out? Get off your ass!"
- "I swear. Help me up, and I will owe you."
- "No, not doing this. Not gonna black out."
- "I'm not indestructible. I guess I needed reminding."
- "Hell yeah. Let's go. I have scores to settle."
- "They won't take me down that way twice."
- "Ugh, how in hell did I let that happen?"
- "Ms. Garcia, book me in for a full checkup. Copy?"
- "I respect it. Thanks for the help."
- "Oh, that's a tailoring expense I didn't need."
- "Appreciate the hand up. These surfaces are filthy."
- "I hope you've had your shot. I'm a walking biohazard."
- "You just denied the enemy a kill. Well done."
- "Ugh, body fluids everywhere. Not in a fun way."
- "Come on, smear them up the walls!"
- "I want to see their smoking remains."
- "Show me how fast you can kill."
- "Okay, killer. Show me how you earned your reputation."
- "There's your target. You know what to do."
